title: Synthetic Healthcare Data Generation using CTGAN and TVAE
summary: A project that generates synthetic healthcare patient data (based on the Synthea dataset) using generative models, with fidelity evaluation, privacy analysis, MLflow tracking, and Streamlit deployment. It runs SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer via sdv.single_table to train and generate the synthetic data.
evidence: src/train.py:9-11 imports CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, SingleTableMetadata from sdv.single_table/sdv.metadata; both instantiated and trained at lines 90 and 119
